cases.question: Was the same AI tested more than once under the same setup to check whether its score stays consistent?

cases.question: Was the same AI tested more than once under the same setup to check whether its score stays consistent?

cases.question: Was the same AI tested more than once under the same setup to check whether its score stays consistent?

cases.question: Was it tested how much scores change when instructions, presentation or the testing setup change?

cases.question: Was it tested how much scores change when instructions, presentation or the testing setup change?

cases.question: Was it tested how much scores change when instructions, presentation or the testing setup change?

cases.question: Was it tested how much scores change when instructions, presentation or the testing setup change?

cases.question: Was the marking method checked for mistakes, such as software bugs, mistakes when reading the AI's answer, or inconsistent human or AI judges?
cases.description: Responses are marked by exact string matching. The report states that no tests or other checks of the marking program were performed.

cases.question: Was the marking method checked for mistakes, such as software bugs, mistakes when reading the AI's answer, or inconsistent human or AI judges?
cases.description: Responses are marked by exact string matching. The marking rules are documented, but the supplied report says nothing about checking the program.

cases.question: Was the marking method checked for mistakes, such as software bugs, mistakes when reading the AI's answer, or inconsistent human or AI judges?
cases.description: Responses are marked by fixed software. Tests cover correct and incorrect strings, empty answers and malformed inputs, and compare the output with manually verified cases. These are all marking paths for this test.

cases.question: Was the marking method checked for mistakes, such as software bugs, mistakes when reading the AI's answer, or inconsistent human or AI judges?
cases.description: Marking uses a parser followed by an AI judge. Parser tests were performed. The report explicitly states that the AI judge was not checked against human marking or for consistent decisions.

cases.question: Are the test materials and methods available in enough detail for someone else to repeat the evaluation or examine how it was done?
cases.description: For the reported evaluation, all test inputs, reference answers, instructions, scoring code, model settings, software versions and output logs are available with a documented procedure for rerunning and inspecting it.

cases.question: Are the test materials and methods available in enough detail for someone else to repeat the evaluation or examine how it was done?
cases.description: Only an aggregate score is available. The authors explicitly withhold all test inputs, scoring details, instructions, code and access for external inspection of the procedure.

cases.question: Are the test materials and methods available in enough detail for someone else to repeat the evaluation or examine how it was done?
cases.description: A sample of tasks and scoring instructions is available for inspection. The remaining tasks and the settings needed to repeat the reported evaluation are explicitly unavailable, and no other inspection access exists.

cases.question: Are the test materials and methods available in enough detail for someone else to repeat the evaluation or examine how it was done?
cases.description: The report gives a score and says that evaluation materials exist. It provides no information about their availability or contents.

cases.question: Is there evidence for any claim that the scores show how well an AI system will perform beyond the problems in this test?
cases.description: The authors claim only the observed scores on the exact tasks administered. The stated use is to describe those runs; no prediction about new tasks or wider performance is proposed.

cases.question: Is there evidence for any claim that the scores show how well an AI system will perform beyond the problems in this test?
cases.description: The authors claim that their puzzle score predicts performance on engineering document tasks. The supplied description contains no study or other evidence examining that relationship.

cases.question: Is there evidence for any claim that the scores show how well an AI system will perform beyond the problems in this test?
cases.description: The authors claim that scores predict performance on unseen tasks sampled from the same specified task population. A separate, prespecified study tests that exact prediction on new tasks and reports a positive relationship with uncertainty estimates and no contradictory findings in the supplied record.

cases.question: Is there evidence for any claim that the scores show how well an AI system will perform beyond the problems in this test?
cases.description: The authors claim that scores predict both unseen grid tasks and engineering document tasks. A separate study supports the grid prediction under matched conditions. The authors state that the engineering prediction has not been investigated and provide no supporting evidence for it.
